conventions.convention: Σ is a nonempty compact smooth three-manifold without boundary; h is smooth Riemannian, N is smooth and strictly positive, and g = −N² dx⁰⊗dx⁰ + h on R×Σ has signature (−,+,+,+). The selected future Killing field is ∂x⁰.

Use SI length coordinates x⁰ = ct_phys. N and metric components are dimensionless; T₀ is in kelvins, μ₀ and qΦ are in joules, and pressure is in pascals. The electrochemical sign convention is μ = (μ₀ − qΦ)/N, and T = T₀/N.

Integration against dV_h means integration against the associated compact-finite Borel measure vol_h, with countable choice assumed. No orientation or identification with the completed measure space is required.
The pressure p is supplied C² data on an open D ⊂ (0,∞)×R containing the local profiles. It is not automatically identified with pressure derived from a material energy function.

W_hs is an adopted order-zero effective functional, with Z_eff := exp(W_hs); neither a microscopic trace nor a thermal state is asserted. The spatial long-wavelength regime is declared separately and supplies no quantitative error or convergence bound.

Only μ₀ varies in the derivative identities, within the open admissible interval U; all background fields, T₀, q and p remain fixed. Susceptibility nonnegativity additionally requires pointwise p_μμ ≥ 0 at the evaluated profile.

The transport comparison assumes an application-specific shared pressure identification and a common admissible local constitutive input with θ ≠ 0. It compares constitutive maps and asserts no balance-equation solution or empirical response.

load_bearing.statement: Prescribe nonempty compact smooth boundaryless Σ, smooth Riemannian h, smooth N > 0 and Φ, fixed q ∈ R, T₀ > 0 and μ₀ ∈ R, with T = T₀/N and μ = (μ₀ − qΦ)/N taking values in the open domain D of a supplied C² pressure function p.

On an open interval U containing μ₀ for which every local profile remains in D, adopt W_hs(T₀,r;h,N,Φ,q,p) = (k_B T₀)⁻¹ ∫Σ N(x)p(T₀/N(x),(r − qΦ(x))/N(x)) dV_h(x), with the integral finite and the background fixed.

For the adopted compact hydrostatic functional, varying only μ₀ within U gives ∂μ₀W_hs = ∫Σ p_μ/(k_B T₀) dV_h and ∂²μ₀W_hs = ∫Σ p_μμ/(N k_B T₀) dV_h, evaluated at the prescribed local profiles. The second derivative is nonnegative if p_μμ is pointwise nonnegative there, and has SI units J⁻².

The underlying ordered-pair set R×Σ.
Lorentzian signature, timelike vectors and time orientation.
The flow-based condition L_ξg = 0 defining a Killing field.
Canonical smooth structure and dimension four for R×Σ.
Smoothness, symmetry and positive definiteness of h.
The coordinate formula √det(h_ij)|dx¹dx²dx³|.
Global definition and orientation independence of dV_h.
Borel-function integration against the density measure, retaining its countable-choice and completion qualifications.
The associated Borel measure and finite total volume on compact Σ.
The explicitly inherited AC_ω premise for geometric and density-integration suppliers.
SI length coordinates, lapse and Killing-temperature normalization, charge-potential units and Boltzmann calibration.
The material state function, observer field, pressure and expansion conventions inherited by the dissipative branch.
The stationary carrier definitions underlying the thermal-geometry supplier, including β = ξ/(k_B T_K).
Restricted adopted material thermodynamics; checked that no automatic identification with the independently supplied hydrostatic pressure is claimed.
Compactness of a bounded closed parameter interval inside U.
Compactness of I₀×Σ.
Compactness of the profile image K and attainment of pressure-derivative bounds and a strictly positive lapse minimum.
Uniform continuity of p_μ and p_μμ on the compact Euclidean profile image.
Uniform estimates for first and second parameter difference quotients.
The cancellation of N in the first derivative and the remaining 1/N factor in the second derivative.
Π = −ζcθ, the definition and inverse-length units of θ, and admissibility of nonnegative constant bulk-viscosity coefficient fields.

seams_checked.note: The actual item edge is the postulate's formulation reference to draft def-tgrx-thermal-vorticity. Its future-timelike Killing β and temperature definition agree with β = ∂x⁰/(k_B T₀) and T = T₀/N on each connected spacetime component. The hydrostatic page does not import an equilibrium-state existence claim or a global obstruction theorem. The supplier page declares no reverse hydrostatic prerequisite.
